info.name: Mail Pop-out
info.summary: Use the Mail composer as a floating or separate window
info.description:
Name: Mail Pop-out ID: mail_popout Author: pmpksamy Website: https://pmpksamy.com App URL: https://pmpksamy.com/nextcloud_app/mail_popout Documentation & Installation Guide URL: https://pmpksamy.com/nextcloud_app/mail_popout Contact: Maalig@pmpksamy.com Version: 1.0.2
Turns the Nextcloud Mail composer into a draggable, resizable floating window and adds a button that can move the live composer into a separate browser window. The original Mail composer remains in control of drafts, attachments, sending, minimizing, and closing.
info.author: pmpksamy
